## Decisions (recorded at implementation)

- **Create seam = project-create-first + workspace-scoped preview.** `POST /import/preview`
  (workspace-scoped — no project id; the quarantine key already carries the workspace prefix and the
  existing project-scoped preview never used its `:id`) previews the conversion before any project
  exists. `POST /projects` then creates the project AND adopts the same quarantined conversion
  (`converted_result` is reused — no duplicate upload or conversion). Recorded per the ticket's Notes
  instruction.
- **Attention groups derive from `projectState` output + row facts** — `overlay === 'needs_you'` →
  Needs you (sorted by soonest unresolved gate `deadline_at`); `overlay === 'running'` → Running;
  `key === 'reviewed'` with the latest letter unopened → Ready to read; everything else → Quiet
  (archived rows stay hidden unless `?archived=1`). No group is ever persisted; the list recomputes.
- **Letter-opened signal**: `correspondence_items.letter_opened_at` (migration `0029`) — stamped once
  on the delivered-dossier GET (`kind='review'`), feeding the existing `letterOpenedAt` input of
  `projectState` (Ready-to-read clears when the deliverable is opened; suggested action flips
  `read_letter` → `revise`).
- **`project_search_docs`** (migration `0029`): one row per `(project_id, kind, ref_id)` —
  `project` (title/venue/Voice name), `draft` (materialized markdown), `letter` (correspondence
  bodies). `tsvector` generated column + GIN index; upserts happen on the write paths (create,
  rename, voice/venue change, import, autosave) plus a self-healing project-row upsert inside the
  search handler so title/voice/venue matches never depend on indexing coverage.
- **Soft delete**: `projects.deleted_at` (0029) — Delete sets it, hidden everywhere, Restore clears
  it within the 30-day window. The restore surface is `/app?deleted=1` (the `?scope=deleted` read on
  `GET /projects`) + `POST /projects/:id/restore`; the `project.purge` enqueue/sweep is the deletion
  surface's work (**D-P1.04-2**, P1.20's `shouldPurgeProject` machinery already exists).
- **Protocol filter + Sort**: `?protocol=<id>` narrows rows by the project's protocol pick and
  `?sort=title` orders each group A–Z (Recent stays the default; Needs-you keeps its deadline order
  regardless). Both are GET params on `/app` — the api never sees them (organisation is a read facet).
- **Voice group headers**: the "N use an older profile" count links to the voice's page — the
  workspace-level entry to Adopt refreshed profile (the Adopt flow itself is PRB.10's/P1.14's).
- **Voice picker groups**: the new-project Voice select renders Your voices / House styles optgroups
  (`mode='house'`), the shared status pill per option, a never-built hint, and a *Create a voice…*
  link — REQ-PERSONA-20's picker contents.
- **Archived semantics**: `archived_at` rows are read-only — run creation refuses with 409
  `project_archived`; Archive/Restore are the row actions.
- **Per-user grouping**: `"user".project_group_by` ('attention' | 'voice'), same pattern as
  `app_theme` (0027) — `GET/PUT /settings/project-grouping`; the Group-by select POSTs through the
  web shell.
- **Protocol cards**: `PROTOCOL_CARDS` (picker metadata — id/name/tagline/entry default/apparatus/
  venue-bar kind) covers all four §6.7 protocols while full `Protocol` bodies stay P1.21's. REQ-GENRE-4
  default: Essay for Unfiled; Academic when the linked Voice's `structure_repertoire` head records
  `apparatus: full`; otherwise the sheet asks once (no preselect).
- **Voice soft-lock**: the list-row "Change voice" action is enabled only while the project has no
  drafts; afterwards it renders disabled with reason ("change it in Voice settings") — the API PATCH
  stays open for the Voice-settings path.
- **Duplicate** copies drafts (new ids, `origin='duplicate'`, same `promoted_version_id` —
  content-addressed versions are shared), outline artifacts (new rows sharing head versions), and
  the Voice link (`persona_id` + pinned `persona_profile_snapshot_id`); correspondence, runs, and
  live_docs are never copied.
